summary: No Man's Sky entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: No Man's Sky

emulation.notes: Native PC route; VR optional only if part of the archive goal.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings/VR if desired

primary.version: Current No Man's Sky PC build
primary.why: No Man's Sky is a long-running updated game across many platforms. Windows PC has the strongest graphics, VR, update, and capture ceiling, while no platform-exclusive story route is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam/GOG/PC build with the latest major update installed. Record game version, save mode, expedition/event availability, and whether VR is used.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a live, heavily updated game. Archive notes must include update/version and expedition/event state.
